coverage_note: Full tree contains one copyable calendar heatmap plus demo/documentation and stock shadcn primitives. Static scanning missed CalendarHeatmap because it is exported at the end of its source. Retain that component and the reusable copy-control variants. Merge the LLM copy-label variant into the general clipboard control; framework layout, header/footer, icon registry, example-code showcase and private demo package do not add independent capability boundaries.
